n: 30 Inch S Series Professional Freestanding Gas Range Stainless Steel
desc: THOR Kitchen 30-inch Professional Freestanding Gas Range is built for those who demand power, precision, and performance in every meal. Designed with heavy-duty, continuous cast-iron cooking grates, it delivers superior stability and effortless movement across five versatile burners—from a high-powered 18,000 BTU burner for rapid boiling and searing to a gentle 3,500 BTU simmer for delicate sauces.
hl: Continuous, heavy-duty cast-iron grates provide superior stability and durability, allowing you to move cookware effortlessly across burners.
From a high-powered 18,000 BTU burner to a steady 3,500 BTU simmer function, this rangetop provides the power you need for large family meals.
Built-in convection fan circulates hot air evenly throughout the oven for faster, more consistent cooking results.
